example: The company switched to sustainable packaging last year.
example2: Governments are under pressure to adopt more sustainable policies.
note: Ключове слово IELTS-есе про довкілля. Часта колокація: sustainable development, sustainable practices.

example: Carbon emissions have risen sharply over the past decade.
example2: The new regulations aim to cut vehicle emissions by 2030.
note: Майже завжди у виразі carbon emissions / greenhouse gas emissions.

example: Air pollution is a major problem in big cities.
example2: Noise pollution from traffic affects residents' sleep.
note: Незлічуваний іменник — без артикля «a» і без множини.

example: Deforestation threatens biodiversity across the region.
example2: Protecting wetlands helps preserve local biodiversity.
note: Часто в парі з дієсловом threaten або preserve.

example: Coral reefs support a fragile ecosystem.
example2: Rising ocean temperatures are disrupting marine ecosystems.

example: The government is investing heavily in renewable energy.
example2: Solar and wind are the fastest-growing renewable resources.

example: Many countries still rely on fossil fuels for electricity.
example2: Burning fossil fuels is the leading cause of global warming.
note: Завжди два слова разом, часто у множині: fossil fuels.

example: Deforestation is one of the leading causes of climate change.
example2: Illegal deforestation continues despite government bans.

example: The park was created for wildlife conservation.
example2: Water conservation is essential during periods of drought.

example: Rising temperatures are destroying the polar bear's habitat.
example2: Urban development has reduced the natural habitat of many species.

example: The region has suffered from severe drought for three years.
example2: Farmers struggled to grow crops during the drought.

example: Carbon dioxide is the most common greenhouse gas.
example2: Methane is a far more potent greenhouse gas than CO2.

example: We recycle paper, glass, and plastic at home.
example2: Most of this packaging can be recycled easily.

example: The factory produces a lot of industrial waste.
example2: The city introduced new rules for waste management.

example: Chemical runoff contaminated the local water supply.
example2: The spill contaminated miles of coastline.
note: Сильніше за «pollute» — часто про воду/їжу з небезпечним ефектом.

example: Ozone depletion was a major concern in the 1990s.
example2: Overfishing has led to the depletion of fish stocks worldwide.

example: Flying frequently increases your carbon footprint significantly.
example2: Many companies now try to reduce their carbon footprint.
note: Дуже поширений вираз у IELTS Writing Task 2 про довкілля.

example: Several endangered species live in this national park.
example2: The organization works to protect endangered wildlife.

example: Coastal erosion is destroying beaches around the world.
example2: Tree roots help prevent soil erosion on hillsides.

example: Rapid urbanization has put pressure on natural resources.
example2: Urbanization often leads to the loss of farmland.

example: Governments must act quickly to mitigate climate change.
example2: Planting trees can help mitigate the effects of flooding.
note: Дуже частотне у формальних текстах про політику й довкілля.

example: Reducing meat consumption can lower your environmental impact.
example2: Energy consumption tends to peak during winter months.

example: The factory released toxic chemicals into the river.
example2: Some household cleaning products contain toxic substances.

example: Stricter environmental regulations were introduced last year.
example2: Companies must comply with new emissions regulations.

example: The company aims to reduce its environmental footprint.
example2: Choosing local produce can shrink your environmental footprint.
note: У переносному сенсі — «вплив», не тільки слід на землі.
